title: Content Reviewer
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning talent network , and we are currently looking for a Content Reviewer to review and evaluate online content to help improve AI responses and overall accuracy. The role involves checking content quality, correctness, and proper categorization according to project guidelines.

If you enjoy working with data, pay close attention to detail, and want to contribute to real-world AI innovation, this is an excellent opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking global team.


Job Title: Content Reviewer

Location: Remote /Brazil

Type: Freelance

Required Engagement: 30 hours per week


Key Responsibilities:

• Review digital content and evaluate its quality and accuracy

• Help improve AI responses by providing accurate evaluations

• Follow project guidelines while reviewing content

• Identify errors, inconsistencies, or inappropriate content

• Categorize and tag content appropriately


Key Requirements:

• Good knowledge of pop culture, brands, and current events

• Understanding of taxonomy and content categorization

• Familiarity with social media platforms is mandatory

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills


Assessment Process:

Candidates will be required to complete the following assessments:

• LLM Evaluation Assessment

• Pearson Versant Assessment (C1/C2 only)

• ICAP MRS Assessment (link will be shared soon)


Candidates who successfully pass all three assessments will be invited for a short interview with the project team .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious, and eager to make an impact in the world of AI, we’d love to have you join our growing network.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) PJ
description:
Qual será o seu papel?

  • Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente.
  • Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes.
  • Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio).
  • Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk).
  • Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD.
  • Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch).
  • Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts.


Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial):

  • Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure).
  • Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura.
  • Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure)


Contratação: PJ.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
About The Product

At Boldin , we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence.

With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future.


About This Role

The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical authority responsible for defining Boldin’s data architecture, setting long-term technical strategy, and tackling our most complex data engineering challenges. This role shapes company-wide data standards, and partners with executive and cross-functional leaders to ensure our data platform scales with the business.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve long-term data architecture and vision
  • Design resilient and scalable data platform and pipelines
  • Set standards for data modeling, reliability, observability, and governance
  • Lead complex, high-risk technical initiatives and migrations
  • Influence tool selection, and technology adoption across the data stack
  • Elevate engineering excellence
  • Partner with leadership to align data strategy and business goals
  • Enable analytics, ML, and product use cases 1KPIS + Targets
  • Uptime: Consistently meets SLA for business-critical pipelines
  • Freshness: All Tier 1 datasets delivered within SLA
  • Delivery predictability: Majority of sprint commitments completed as planned
  • Cost optimization: Year-over-year efficiency improvement as data scales
  • Documentation: Full coverage for all production-grade assets


Qualifications

Technical Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering or related disciplines
  • Proficient in SQL, Python, or related languages
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP)
  • Strong experience with data warehouse, data lakes, and distributed systems
  • Strong experience with modern data stack (Athena, BigQuery, Glue, Spark, Dataproc, Kafka, Flink, dbt, Kestra, Fivetran or equivalent)
  • Proven ability to build and maintain production-grade ELT/ETL pipelines
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Cloud Composer)
  • Experience implementing data quality and observability frameworks
  • Performance and cost optimization in cloud warehouses
  • Good spoken English


Product & Business Partnership:

  • Experience supporting product analytics and experimentation
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data models
  • Strong ownership and accountability for SLAs


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with Kubernetes
  • Experience structuring data for ML or AI use cases
  • Familiarity with Amplitude or product event pipelines
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or fintech environment
  • Influencing technical direction without direct managerial authority


Benefits:

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Collections Policy Analyst
description:
Senior Collections Policy Analyst


What You’ll Do


  • Analyze the behavior of customers with short-, medium-, and long-term delinquencies to identify opportunities for improvement;
  • Create and refine data-driven collections policies to reduce risk and increase recovery;
  • Use SQL and Python to extract insights and generate strategic reports;
  • Explain to the business and sales teams why analytical strategies work and demonstrate the value of the solutions;
  • Work closely with the Data Science and Operations teams.


What we’re looking for


  • Experience: Previous experience with data analysis focused on collections or credit risk;
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, BigQuery, and Python;
  • Practical Approach: Ability to translate numbers into actions that solve customer problems;
  • Communication: Ability to explain complex results in a simple way to different teams;
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or related fields.


Differentiators


  • Knowledge of discount policies, portfolio write-offs, and pricing
  • English


------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Analista Sénior de Políticas de Cobranças


O que irá fazer


  • Analisar o comportamento dos clientes com incumprimentos a curto, médio e longo prazo para identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Criar e aperfeiçoar políticas de cobranças baseadas em dados para reduzir o risco e aumentar a recuperação;
  • Utilizar SQL e Python para extrair insights e gerar relatórios estratégicos;
  • Explicar às equipas comerciais e de vendas por que razão as estratégias analíticas funcionam e demonstrar o valor das soluções;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipas de Ciência de Dados e Operações.


O que procuramos


  • Experiência: Experiência anterior em análise de dados focada em cobranças ou risco de crédito;
  • Competências técnicas: Proficiência em SQL, BigQuery e Python;
  • Abordagem prática: Capacidade de traduzir números em ações que resolvam os problemas dos clientes;
  • Comunicação: Capacidade de explicar resultados complexos de forma simples a diferentes equipas;
  • Formação: Licenciatura em Matemática, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas afins.


Diferenciais


  • Conhecimento de políticas de descontos, baixas de carteira e precificação;
  • Inglês.

description:
We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.

With over 8,000 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.


We are looking for a Senior .NET Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development and integration of complex software solutions focused on back-end development. title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Analista de Geracao de Demanda TI II
description:

Principais atividades:

  • Atualização dos controles de gerenciamento de projetos (cronograma, prazos, riscos, pendências e pagamentos);
  • Atuar/apoiar no planejamento orçamentário anual das necessidades da área, levantando alternativas de solução e estimativas alto nível, considerando as despesas recorrentes das áreas, avaliando reajustes de contratos, eventuais cancelamentos, aditivos e oportunidades de redução.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Formação superior completa, preferencialmente nas áreas de TI (Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia/Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Processamento de Dados e outros) ou Administração.Pós-graduação (diferencial)
  • Necessário experiência com metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban)Necessário conhecimento em pacote Office, principalmente em Excel e Power PointNecessário conhecimento básico em MS Project para gestão de cronograma, ferramentas como Jira e MIRO são desejáveis.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to planning, daily stand-ups, and continuous collaboration to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software.



Competencies/Requirements:


  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Onboarding Specialist - Contractor
description:
About SleekFlow

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth globally thanks to the support of renowned investors like Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund and Tiger Global. Our mission is to develop the next generation of Conversational AI, empowering customer interactions across all channels—from messaging to voice—and enhancing business workflows and processes.

You will have the opportunity to thrive alongside the company through equity options. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and assume a larger role, we look forward to meeting you!


At SleekFlow, we have developed an all-in-one Omnichannel Conversation AI Suite that drives conversions through conversations. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our AI customer engagement platform, enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams.

As we aggressively expand into emerging markets, we seek adventurous, diverse, and passionate individuals to join us on this exciting journey. Join our team and grow your career with SleekFlow!


Associate Level

Location: Brazil

Prior Experience in SaaS/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: Portuguese and business-level fluency in English


Responsibilities

  • Educating customers and optimizing their product setup for the quickest path to success.
  • Providing materials to help customers learn best practices to achieve their desired outcomes faster and more efficiently.
  • Work with sales, product, and support teams to ensure that each piece of the journey meets customer expectations.
  • Handle incoming enquiries via emails, calls and chats in a professional manner.
  • Build evergreen content and resources for customers (and other organizations) to use for education and to drive rapid product adoption.
  • Be a SleekFlow expert and discuss or educate on any nuance of the product internally and externally.
  • Work continuously to document the details of each interaction in order to easily research customer issues and to inform product improvements


Skills and Qualifications

  • Good command of both written and spoken Portuguese and English
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in communications, customer service and support, sales, account management, or customer success. Customer success courses / training are good to have.
  • Ability to learn, adapt and thrive quickly in a dynamic environment
  • Comfortable to engage with a diverse array of customers
  • Problem solving and critical thinking with detail oriented
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills (written & verbal)
  • Strong customer obsession attitude with evidence of taking independent and appropriate decisions for the customer
  • Strong computer skills, including CRM, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Team player with the desire to try new ideas in order to achieve greater levels of success


What We Offer

  • Competitive base package
  • 20 working days per month
  • Fun and diverse culture
  • International team environment
  • Constant & rigorous training from experience team leads


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.


SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

title: Back-End Developer Golang  SR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Enquanto desenvolvedor sênior, será esperado de você uma capacidade técnica e analítica profunda sobre o que já foi implementado no projeto.

você será uma referencia técnica no time, e deverá exercer certa influencia de liderança. Deverá ser demandado, na maior parte do tempo, em caráter de auxiliador de desenvolvedores mais júniores e, por isso, o comprometimento com a inovação e aquisição de conhecimento dentro do universo Android se faz

essencial para o seu nível de carreira.

Responsabilidades e atribuições



  • Atuar com profunda capacidade técnica e analítica sobre o que já foi implementado no projeto, garantindo evolução contínua das soluções;
  • Ser referência técnica dentro do time, exercendo influência de liderança e apoiando desenvolvedores mais júniores;
  • Contribuir diretamente para inovação e aquisição de conhecimento no ecossistema Android e demais tecnologias envolvidas;
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs REST de alta performance;
  • Projetar e implementar serviços resilientes, escaláveis e tolerantes a falhas;
  • Atuar na otimização de latência, throughput e desempenho de sistemas de alta volumetria;
  • Implementar estratégias avançadas de caching, incluindo Redis distribuído;
  • Aplicar rate limiting, circuit breaker e mecanismos de backpressure;
  • Realizar profiling e tuning de aplicações para máxima eficiência;
  • Trabalhar em modelagem de banco de dados orientada à performance e escalabilidade;
  • Atuar com bancos relacionais e não relacionais, conforme as demandas do projeto;
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de microsserviços em produção, garantindo consistência e disponibilidade;
  • Implementar práticas de observabilidade, monitoramento e tracing distribuído;
  • Atuar com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).




Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência avançada com Golang;
  • Profundo entendimento de concorrência com goroutines, channels e context;
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de APIs REST de alta performance;
  • Sólido conhecimento no design de serviços resilientes e escaláveis;
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta volumetria (milhares ou milhões de requisições);
  • Conhecimento em otimização de latência e throughput;
  • Experiência com estratégias de caching, especialmente Redis distribuído;
  • Domínio de técnicas como rate limiting, circuit breaker e backpressure;
  • Habilidade em profiling e tuning de aplicações;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL/MySQL);
  • Experiência com bancos não relacionais (MongoDB ou similares);
  • Prática com microsserviços em produção e fundamentos de sistemas distribuídos (consistência, tolerância a falhas, observabilidade);
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logging e tracing distribuído;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).

description:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;

Highly Desirable Skills

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Salesforce Software Engineer | LATAM
description:
We are hiring experienced Software Engineers  to join our team and build on the Salesforce platform. These are hands-on engineering roles — you will be writing code, designing solutions, and shipping features across a large, mature codebase. We are not looking for administrators or declarative-only builders; we need engineers who think in code and architecture.

We're hiring across both UI/Frontend  and Backend/Platform  specializations, and you'll work on a production Experience Cloud site built with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Bootstrap, supported by a robust backend of Apex services, integrations, and asynchronous processing.



What You'll Work On


Frontend / UI Engineers  will focus on:

  • Building and maintaining Lightning Web Components within an Experience Cloud site serving external users
  • Working with Bootstrap-based styling and responsive layouts alongside the LWC framework
  • Designing component architectures that are performant, accessible, and maintainable at scale
  • Integrating frontend components with Apex controllers, platform events, and real-time data flows

Backend / Platform Engineers  will focus on:

  • Designing and building Apex services, triggers, and automation across a complex data model
  • Implementing and maintaining asynchronous processing patterns including Queueable Apex, Batchable Apex, and Platform Events
  • Working with the Connect API and other Salesforce platform APIs
  • Building and supporting MuleSoft integrations for document processing and connectivity to external systems
  • Ensuring governor limit compliance, bulkification, and performance optimization across high-volume operations

All engineers  will contribute to code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.



Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline — we value a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, systems design, and software engineering principles
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , with a meaningful portion spent writing code on the Salesforce platform (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Visualforce)
  • Demonstrated experience building large-scale applications  — you've worked in codebases with significant complexity, not just small apps or proof-of-concept projects
  • Experience building cloud-native or cloud-hosted applications  — you understand multi-tenant architecture, API-driven design, and the tradeoffs of building on a managed platform
  • Proficiency with modern AI-assisted development tools  (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) — you actively use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review, and you understand how to validate and guide AI-generated output effectively
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals : version control (Git), testing strategies, CI/CD, separation of concerns, and clean code practices



Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud  (Community Cloud) site development
  • Hands-on experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC)  in production
  • Experience with MuleSoft  (Anypoint Platform, API-led connectivity, CloudHub)
  • Familiarity with Platform Events  and event-driven architecture on Salesforce
  • Experience with Batchable and Queueable Apex  patterns for high-volume data processing
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce Connect API
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II  (valued but not required — we care more about what you can build than what you've passed)
  • Experience with Bootstrap  or similar CSS frameworks in the context of LWC development
  • Familiarity with document processing pipelines and integration patterns

title: Analista de Middleware Sênior (PJ)
description:
Atividades:

Conduzir salas de War Room para resolução de causa raiz de problemas ligados a Produção, atuando diretamente no ambiente, organizando a linha de troubleshooting, fomentando possíveis soluções de correção definitivas e/ou alternativas, consolidando e comunicando o report para o cliente e gerência;

Identificar problemas relacionados a aplicação e suas camadas e arquitetura e solução (APACHE, Weblogic, Banco de Dados, Load Balance, Redes e etc) e suas integrações com sistemas de front end;

Resolução de problemas de alta complexidade e identificação de RCA;

Colaborar com a gestão de TI e controles internos na sustentação de sistemas, visando priorizar as principais TIRs (melhorias);

Fomentar e elaborar propostas para otimizar e automatizar processos operacionais a partir da análise de cuasa raiz dos eventos que afetam a Produção;

Analisar tendências de incidentes/problemas e propor soluções preventivas bem como a solução definitiva;

Propor automações e monitorações que antecipem cenários de problema;

Implantar soluções de IA, ML e automações que antecipem problemas e atuem na resolução de maneira, cada vez mais assertiva e rápida;

Instalação de upgrades, manutenção e monitoramento de sistemas/processos;

Análise de perdas e ganhos de KPI (Key Performance Indicator) dentro da área de produção;

Elaboração de IOPs (Instruções Operacionais) para resolver possíveis Gaps de projetos e melhorar experiência do cliente;

Análise de perda de SLA (Service Level Agreemente) por meio de PowerBI e e Banco de dados para fluxo de vendas, que impactam diretamente a experiência do cliente;

Monitoração dos ambientes de produção, através de ELK Stack, Grafana, Zabbix, Kibana;

Melhoria contínua do fluxo de produção em nível operacional, através de correções de problemas por INCs, BUGs e TIRs;

Disponibilidade de horário e escala 24x7.


Conhecimentos específicos:

Seja formado na área de exatas, preferivelmente sistemas de informação ou informática e afins;

Ótima capacidade de comunicação oratória e escrita, principalmente em cenários de WR com executivos;

Experiencia em ambientes com WebLogic, Containers Docker e Kubernets;

Experiencia em ambientes com banco de dados;

Experiencia em troubleshooting envolvendo camadas de infra como Redes, Balanceadores, Firewall;

Experiencia em manutenção de aplicações hospedadas em cloud;

Experiência em camada de observabilidade;

Experiência em ambiente UNIX/Linux e Windows;

Experiencia em suporte a aplicações de Ordering e Integrações;

Experiencia em análise de logs, mapeamento de ofensores e direcionamento de causas raiz;

Experiencia em operação de contratos com KPIs e SLAs;

Comunicação padrão Soap/Rest e análise de Json/XML;


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

Seja um perfil de dinâmico, “falador”, que conduza os troubleshootings, que fale nas salas, se incomode com os problemas e busque alternativas para resolvê-los.

Experiência em ordering, gateway e facilidade de compreensão do end to end;

Operação em sistemas de integração;

Experiencia em implantação de Automações e IA efetivamente;

Experiência em empresas de Telecom;


Contratação: PJ.

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
  • Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.


What We’re Looking For



  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Data Analyst
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 13k-18k BRL/mo.


Must-Haves:

  • 2-5 years of experience in a data engineering/ analyst role
  • Experience with Python (ETL, transformations)
  • PySpark specifically (via Databricks)
  • Familiarity with pandas‑style transformations
  • Experience with SQL for database querying and management
  • Experience with Tableau
  • Strong visual storytelling
  • Ability to innovate and make dashboards genuinely usable


Nice-To-Haves:

  • Experience working with Databricks

Day to day:

A client of Insight Global is looking to hire a data analyst to join their team remotely in the LATAM region. This person will be responsible for partnering directly with business stakeholders to define KPIs, gather requirements, and deliver end to end data solutions. This person's main focus will be on enabling the business through clean data, strong analytics, and exceptional visualization. This person will not be maintaining existing pipelines, but building new ones to support the client's strategic initiatives.

Key responsibilities listed below:

  • Partner 1:1 with business stakeholders to:
  • Understand goals and initiatives
  • Define KPIs and success metrics
  • Perform end‑to‑end data work:
  • Identify and validate data sources
  • Transform data to align with business goals
  • Build net‑new ETL pipelines as needed
  • Develop dashboards and reporting in Tableau that:
  • Tell a clear story
  • Are visually polished and intuitive
  • Are suitable for senior leadership consumption
  • Create presentations and insights that support executive decision‑making
  • Operate in a project‑based environment with ownership from intake to delivery

title: Especialista em Plant Simulation (PJ)
description:
Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna.
  • Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0).
  • Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças.
  • Integração de Dados: Conectar os modelos de simulação com bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle), planilhas e outros sistemas corporativos (ERP, MES, PLM).
  • Apresentação de Resultados: Traduzir dados técnicos de simulação em relatórios claros e dashboards para a diretoria e gerentes de planta.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter (Essencial):

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência prática com o Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation .
  • Domínio de programação em SimTalk .
  • Conhecimento forte em Estatística aplicada à simulação (distribuições de probabilidade, validação de dados de entrada e análise de saída).
  • Visão de Processos Industriais (Lean Manufacturing, tempos e métodos, gargalos).

O que vai te destacar (Diferencial):

  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas Siemens (Process Simulate, NX MCD, Teamcenter).
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação adicionais (Python, C++, SQL).
  • Experiência com emulação (comissionamento virtual conectando o modelo a PLCs reais).


Contratação: PJ.

title: Atlassian Consultant | Customer Facing Technical Expert
description:
Company Description

At Atlas Bench, we specialize in transforming teamwork through tailored solutions for Atlassian products. Our global team of experts in DevOps, ITSM, and agile methodologies delivers innovative services, including AI-driven integrations, managed licensing, and consulting. Trusted by over 1,000 clients, including Fortune 500 companies, we provide comprehensive support, from Jira and Confluence training to Asset Management in JSM. Join us in reshaping the future of collaboration and technology-enabled teamwork.


Role Description

This is a full-time hybrid role for an Atlassian Customer Facing Technical Expert, based in the Greater São Paulo Area with some flexibility for remote work. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer support, ensuring customer satisfaction, and resolving technical inquiries related to Atlassian products. You will also assist with analyzing client challenges, recommending tailored solutions, and providing training on Atlassian tools and best practices.

  • Strong Customer Support and Customer Satisfaction skills, with a focus on delivering excellent service and building client relationships

  • Analytical Skills to assess client needs, troubleshoot issues, and recommend solutions
  • Experience with Atlassian tools (such as Jira, Confluence, and JSM) and a deep understanding of their applications
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a hybrid environment, balancing onsite and remote work
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred
  • Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role and fluency in Portuguese and English are highly beneficial

title: Immigration Paralegal (PORTUGUESE SPEAKER)
description:
Company Description

Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.


Role Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents
  • Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy
  • Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups
  • Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries
  • Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance
  • Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials
  • Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)
  • Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations
  • Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism


Qualifications

  • Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases
  • Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only

﻿

  • To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to . Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Especialista em Plant Simulation (PJ)
description:
Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna.
  • Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0).
  • Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças.
  • Integração de Dados: Conectar os modelos de simulação com bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle), planilhas e outros sistemas corporativos (ERP, MES, PLM).
  • Apresentação de Resultados: Traduzir dados técnicos de simulação em relatórios claros e dashboards para a diretoria e gerentes de planta.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter (Essencial):

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência prática com o Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation .
  • Domínio de programação em SimTalk .
  • Conhecimento forte em Estatística aplicada à simulação (distribuições de probabilidade, validação de dados de entrada e análise de saída).
  • Visão de Processos Industriais (Lean Manufacturing, tempos e métodos, gargalos).

O que vai te destacar (Diferencial):

  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas Siemens (Process Simulate, NX MCD, Teamcenter).
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação adicionais (Python, C++, SQL).
  • Experiência com emulação (comissionamento virtual conectando o modelo a PLCs reais).

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.

  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.

  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.

If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Immigration Paralegal (PORTUGUESE SPEAKER)
description:
Company Description

Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.


Role Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents
  • Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy
  • Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups
  • Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries
  • Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance
  • Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials
  • Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)
  • Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations
  • Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism


Qualifications

  • Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases
  • Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only

﻿

To Apply

  • To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to . Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

Análise de perda de SLA (Service Level Agreemente) por meio de PowerBI e e Banco de dados para fluxo de vendas, que impactam diretamente a experiência do cliente;

Monitoração dos ambientes de produção, através de ELK Stack, Grafana, Zabbix, Kibana;

Melhoria contínua do fluxo de produção em nível operacional, através de correções de problemas por INCs, BUGs e TIRs;

Disponibilidade de horário e escala 24x7.

Seja formado na área de exatas, preferivelmente sistemas de informação ou informática e afins;

Ótima capacidade de comunicação oratória e escrita, principalmente em cenários de WR com executivos;

Experiencia em ambientes com WebLogic, Containers Docker e Kubernets;

Experiencia em ambientes com banco de dados;

Experiencia em troubleshooting envolvendo camadas de infra como Redes, Balanceadores, Firewall;

Experiencia em manutenção de aplicações hospedadas em cloud;

Experiência em camada de observabilidade;

Experiência em ambiente UNIX/Linux e Windows;

Experiencia em suporte a aplicações de Ordering e Integrações;

Experiencia em análise de logs, mapeamento de ofensores e direcionamento de causas raiz;

Experiencia em operação de contratos com KPIs e SLAs;

Comunicação padrão Soap/Rest e análise de Json/XML;

Experiência em ordering, gateway e facilidade de compreensão do end to end;

Operação em sistemas de integração;

Experiencia em implantação de Automações e IA efetivamente;

Experiência em empresas de Telecom;

title: Data & AI Tech Lead
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
The Role

Our client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform built for social media managers, agencies, and brands. We are self-funded, profitable, and moving fast, which means the people here are not here to coast. Everyone on this team has a goal they are building toward and puts in the work to get there. If you are looking for a place where your effort directly shapes company growth and your own earnings, this is it.


We are looking for a sharp, disciplined Account Executive who closes deals without losing the relationship along the way. You are not just good on a call. You are the person who sends the follow-up within the hour, keeps prospects warm through a 30-day cycle, and never lets a qualified lead go cold because of a dropped ball on your end.


You will work inbound leads from our SDR team and marketing channels. Prospecting and sourcing are handled upstream. Your job is to convert.

What you'll do

  • Work exclusively with warm, SDR-qualified and inbound leads. You are not cold calling. You are closing.
  • Run structured discovery calls that uncover real pain, not surface-level answers
  • Deliver demos tailored to what you learned in discovery, not a canned deck
  • Own the full sales cycle from first call to signed contract
  • Keep every open opportunity engaged with timely, relevant follow-up
  • Send clear, concise follow-up emails after every call the same day
  • Maintain clean, accurate pipeline records in CRM at all times
  • Partner with SDRs to ensure tight handoffs and fast response on warm leads
  • Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets consistently
  • Feed insights back into messaging, objection handling, and playbooks


Additional Requirements

  • 3+ years of closing experience in a B2B SaaS AE role

  • Exceptional discovery skills. You know how to ask questions that surface real buying motivation and you do not move to demo until you have earned it
  • Organized to a fault. You have a system for follow-up and you never miss a touchpoint because something slipped through the cracks
  • Strong written communication. Your follow-up emails are short, clear, and move the deal forward. Not essays, not templates that feel like templates
  • Fluency in HubSpot or comparable CRM. Pipeline hygiene is not something you need to be reminded about
  • Self-managed. You own your pipeline and your outcomes without needing a manager to push you
  • Resilient and persistent without being annoying. You know the difference between a dead deal and a deal that needs one more touch
