title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Somos uma plataforma que ajuda investidores a encontrarem as melhores oportunidades de investimentos. Temos como base a filosofia Buy And Hold (Investimento de longo prazo). Trazemos para nossos usuários informações como: cotações, balanços, comparadores, históricos financeiros das empresas, gráficos, cursos, gerenciador de carteiras, entre outras funcionalidades. Lançada em dezembro de 2020, a plataforma vem tendo um ótimo crescimento, mensalmente já são mais de 18 milhões de pageviews acessadas.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Designer Sênior com conhecimento em UX e foco em UI para elevar a experiência visual dos nossos produtos digitais. Você será responsável por transformar ideias em interfaces funcionais, consistentes e visualmente impecáveis — garantindo que design e negócio caminhem juntos. Procuramos alguém com olhar estético apurado, pensamento sistêmico e domínio técnico em design de interface, que entenda profundamente de sistemas de design, usabilidade e consistência visual em escala.


Escopo de atividades:


  • Desenhar interfaces digitais completas (web e mobile) com atenção a detalhes, consistência e acessibilidade.
  • Traduzir fluxos e requisitos de produto em soluções visuais escaláveis, dentro do design system.
  • Criar e evoluir componentes, padrões visuais e guidelines em colaboração com a área de Produto e de Tecnologia.
  • Garantir a qualidade visual e coerência entre plataformas (web, iOS, Android).
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com Product Managers e Engineers desde a concepção até a entrega.
  • Colaborar com a gestão com relação: wireframes e protótipos, adicionando clareza, hierarquia e emoção visual.
  • Participar de rituais de produto e trazer um olhar das boas práticas de design centrado no usuário.
  • Monitorar tendências de UI, motion e design systems para manter o produto atualizado e competitivo.


Requisitos Técnicos:


  • Experiência em Product Design ou UI Design em empresas digitais, startups ou scale-ups.
  • Portfólio sólido com interfaces de alta qualidade, demonstrando domínio de layout, tipografia, cor, hierarquia visual e pixel-perfect.
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma (componentes, auto layout, prototyping, variables).
  • Experiência prática em design systems e bibliotecas compartilhadas.
  • Familiaridade com guidelines de plataformas (Material Design, Human Interface Guidelines).
  • Entendimento de boas práticas de front-end (HTML, CSS, responsividade) para colaborar com devs.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Diferenciais:


  • Olhar crítico e alto padrão estético — “good taste + usability sense”.
  • Comunicação clara e empática com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Mentalidade de produto: entende métricas, trade-offs e impacto de design no negócio.
  • Organização e ownership: cuida do design system e documenta decisões.
  • Curiosidade e atualização constante sobre tendências visuais, tipografia e acessibilidade.
  • Perfil: resiliente, colaborativo e resolutivo.
  • Ser investidor e/ou conhecer o mercado de investimentos. 


Informações Complementares:


  • Ambiente de trabalho agradável e organizado;
  • Trabalho 100% Remoto;
  • Horário flexível;


Salário: a combinar

title: LLM Scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist \" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.


Key Responsibilities

Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.

Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.

Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.

Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.

Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.


Qualification Required

Extensive experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).

Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.

Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS SageMaker/GCP Vertex Al).

Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.


Nice to Have

Advanced Degree: A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.

Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.

Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).

Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public GitHub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the GenAl space.

Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.


About Our Client

Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.


Benefits & Wellbeing

Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.

The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees’ well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Atuar na linha de frente da operação diária, sendo o responsável direto pelo monitoramento em tempo real, integridade dos mercados e coordenação ágil de respostas a incidentes para garantir uma experiência de jogo ininterrupta.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget

  • Wellbeing Support

We only accept CVs that are in English.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Especialista em Governança, Arquitetura e FinOps em Ambientes Multicloud (Temporário)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades/Atividades

  • Avaliação sobre existência de processo de desligamento de recursos e análise de consumo;
  • Avaliação do processo de Bilhetagem Multicloud controlado pelo Broker (tecnicamente consistente, transparente, rastreável, íntegro e aderente aos contratos de multicloud);
  • Avaliação do processo de integração Bilhetagem × Arquitetura × FinOps (decisões técnicas consideram impacto na bilhetagem futura, consumo observado pelo Broker é utilizado para corrigir arquitetura e feedback entre custo x engenharia x arquitetura);
  • Avaliar se a empresa conhece e considera o uso dos recursos nativos disponíveis nos CSPs já contratados (Azure, AWS, GCP, etc), especialmente para custo e previsibilidade;
  • Avaliação sobre a existência de uma análise de custo × benefício antes da decisão sobre a arquitetura utilizada (tráfego entre clouds, serviços premium, lock-in);
  • Participação em discussões e reuniões técnicas para entendimento e avaliação do ambiente de multicloud.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Ensino superior completo. Área de formação: Ciências da Computação, Sistemas da Informação, Engenharia, e/ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos

  • Experiência prática comprovada em ambientes multicloud (desejável pelo menos AWS e Azure);
  • Vivência com ambientes que usam mais de um CSP em paralelo;
  • Análise crítica de dependência excessiva de um CSP e riscos de lock-in, impactos arquiteturais de decisões financeiras;
  • Entendimento claro de princípios de FinOps, relação entre consumo técnico e custo (obrigatório );
  • Experiência avaliando consumo, desperdício e eficiência em ambientes cloud (obrigatório) ;
  • Capacidade de analisar impacto de arquitetura no custo e decisões técnicas vs. impacto financeiro (obrigatório) ;
  • Experiência avaliando modelos de Cloud Broker e processo de bilhetagem multicloud (obrigatório) ;
  • Capacidade de Benchmark e Referenciais de Mercado em relação a modelos adotados por grandes empresas e boas práticas de mercado;
  • Capacidade de apresentar alternativas, padrões e caminhos possíveis;
  • Capacidade de discutir tecnicamente em alto nível levando em consideração tendências e soluções de cloud adotadas pelo mercado.


Habilidades e Atitudes Desejáveis

  • Disponibilidade para atuação temporária em um único projeto - 1 a 2 meses.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva junto ao cliente.
  • Comprometimento e responsabilidades com as entregas de projetos nos prazos e com qualidade esperada.

title: Instrutor de Idiomas
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! 


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 600 professores e 7.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 15.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e têm agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. 


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. 


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.


Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability


O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição


  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.


Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience to join our U.S. client's software engineering team. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.

The senior-level position will be part of the client's Intelligence team. This business intelligence solution brings data from multiple products onto one platform, enabling analysis and data-driven insights. Responsibilities will focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that converts raw data into a format ready for ingestion by a BI tool. The individual will coordinate with the implementation team to provide on-time deliverables, quality products, and exceptional customer service.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that power clients' products, which support core product functionality, customer reporting, and internal analytics.
  • Take end‑to‑end ownership of data flows, from ingestion to delivery, with a focus on data quality and reliability.
  • Create and maintain production‑grade database views and transformation logic.
  • Develop, optimize, and manage SQL view scripts and transformations.
  • Design, configure, and maintain database architectures, distributed systems, and data storage solutions.
  • Ensure data integrity by implementing validation processes for data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize data queries and workflows for efficiency.
  • Build and support data integrations with internal services and third‑party APIs, managing authentication, schema evolution, rate limits, and error handling. Proactively adapt pipelines as client products and customer needs grow.
  • Research and recommend innovative approaches for project execution. Recommend areas for improvement in internal processes along with possible solutions, providing status reports to stakeholders, and addressing issues as appropriate.
  • Participate with the team in problem resolution regarding systems and procedures. Assists the team or supervisor in identifying data anomalies and providing business solutions.
  • Document procedures using text, workflow diagrams, and screenshots from the application. Develops and maintains installations and configuration procedures. Provides documentation for institutional workflow processes associated with the application.


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience
  • 3+ years SQL and Python experience
  • Knowledge of database architecture and management
  • Experience working with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, etc.)
  • Ability to read code and convert programming logic from one language to another
  • Familiarity with APIs


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, Sisense)
  • Experience with Apache Airflow
  • Experience with AI coding tools and/or AI assistants
  • Background in Math, Stats, Machine Learning


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Responsibilities:

  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience (Vue.js, React.js, or Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes

  • Rapid learner, as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner, as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.



Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:


  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.



What You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.


Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst

About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.



Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.


Competências esperadas

  • Excelente capacidade de priorização

  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description:
Position Overview
As a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. A significant component of this position involves coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to Level 1 help desk technicians, contributing directly to the team's growth and the achievement of leadership goals. You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems. Position title: Senior Helpdesk Support SpecialistLocation: Remote - LATAM
Key Responsibilities
  • Help supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation.
  • Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to Level 1 helpdesk technicians to support their professional development and ensure overall team success.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex end-user IT issues, providing advanced second-level support for computer systems, hardware, and software.
  • Manage small-scale IT projects, overseeing tasks and special assignments to ensure successful completion and alignment with departmental objectives.
  • Proactively identify recurring technical problems, implementing permanent solutions and making recommendations for IT improvements to reduce incident volume.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by installing, modifying, and repairing computer software, and peripherals on Windows operating systems.
  • Perform basic network triage for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points to resolve initial connectivity issues before escalation.
  • Execute fundamental administrative tasks in Active Directory, such as account unlocks and password resets, and provide end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions.
  • Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets.
  • Develop, preserve, and grow a comprehensive knowledge base of procedures and solutions for both internal help desk use and end-user self-help resources.
  • Strong documentation discipline and ability to follow and improve SOPs and knowledge base articles
  • Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems.
  • Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation.
  • Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Proven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians.
  • Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools.
  • Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows.
  • Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365.
  • Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base.
  • Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment.
Nice to Have Skills
  • Professional IT certifications, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft IT Support.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment via Windows Autopilot and performing machine resets.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting to automate routine administrative tasks.
  • Knowledge of supporting additional operating systems, such as macOS, iOS, or Android.
  • Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools.
Soft Skills
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success.
  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions.
  • Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences.
  • A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity.
  • Proven ability to work effectively within a high-performing team environment, collaborating with colleagues and assisting other IT support teams to share knowledge and achieve common goals.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, including the ability to manage small IT projects, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and exercise sound judgment in tracking, routing, and escalating support tickets.
Why You Will Love Working with Us
Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology Professional development opportunities with international customers Collaborative work environment Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusiveenvironment for all employees.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience to join our U.S. client's software engineering team. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.

The senior-level position will be part of the client's Intelligence team. This business intelligence solution brings data from multiple products onto one platform, enabling analysis and data-driven insights. Responsibilities will focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that converts raw data into a format ready for ingestion by a BI tool. The individual will coordinate with the implementation team to provide on-time deliverables, quality products, and exceptional customer service.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that power clients' products, which support core product functionality, customer reporting, and internal analytics.
  • Take end‑to‑end ownership of data flows, from ingestion to delivery, with a focus on data quality and reliability.
  • Create and maintain production‑grade database views and transformation logic.
  • Develop, optimize, and manage SQL view scripts and transformations.
  • Design, configure, and maintain database architectures, distributed systems, and data storage solutions.
  • Ensure data integrity by implementing validation processes for data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize data queries and workflows for efficiency.
  • Build and support data integrations with internal services and third‑party APIs, managing authentication, schema evolution, rate limits, and error handling. Proactively adapt pipelines as client products and customer needs grow.
  • Research and recommend innovative approaches for project execution. Recommend areas for improvement in internal processes along with possible solutions, providing status reports to stakeholders, and addressing issues as appropriate.
  • Participate with the team in problem resolution regarding systems and procedures. Assists the team or supervisor in identifying data anomalies and providing business solutions.
  • Document procedures using text, workflow diagrams, and screenshots from the application. Develops and maintains installations and configuration procedures. Provides documentation for institutional workflow processes associated with the application.


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience
  • 3+ years SQL and Python experience
  • Knowledge of database architecture and management
  • Experience working with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, etc.)

  • Familiarity with APIs


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, Sisense)

  • Experience with AI coding tools and/or AI assistants
  • Background in Math, Stats, Machine Learning


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a GoodWe em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
  • Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
  • Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
  • Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
  • Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
  • Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
  • Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
  • Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
  • Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
  • Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
  • Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
  • Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
  • Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
  • Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
  • Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
  • Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
  • Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
  • Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
  • Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
  • Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
  • Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.


Habilidades Requeridas

  • Proficiência em mandarim
  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
  • Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
  • Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
  • Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
  • Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
  • Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
  • Excelentes conhecimentos em AutoCAD e PVSyst;
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
  • Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
  • Conhecimento avançado em MS PowerPoint;
  • Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
  • Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.


Atributos

  • Proatividade;
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
  • Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
  • Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Multitarefa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
  • Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.
