title: Pessoa Engenheiro de dados HR
description:
Pessoa Engenheiro de Dados HR (Foco LATAM) - 100% REMOTO


Você é apaixonado por transformar dados em decisões estratégicas e quer atuar em uma das maiores multinacionais do setor de Ciências da Vida e Saúde? Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados Especialista para liderar a evolução da nossa arquitetura de dados de RH na região LATAM!

Nesta posição, você será a peça-chave para conectar as necessidades locais à nossa excelência global, construindo soluções que impactam milhares de colaboradores.


O que você fará:

- Liderar o design e implementação do nosso HR Data Lake/Lakehouse para a América Latina.

- Construir pipelines ETL/ELT robustos e escaláveis, integrando diversas fontes de dados internas e externas.

- Garantir a governança e segurança, assegurando total aderência à LGPD e padrões globais de privacidade.

- Colaborar com times globais e regionais de Engenharia e Ciência de Dados para padronizar nossa arquitetura analítica.

- Estabelecer controles de qualidade e observabilidade de dados para garantir a máxima confiabilidade das informações.


O que buscamos (Requisitos):

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro de Dados.

- Domínio avançado de Python e SQL.

- Expertise em Databricks e arquitetura de dados (conceitos de Lakehouse).

- Experiência prática em Nuvem, com preferência em Azure.

- Inglês Avançado (essencial para interação com o time global).

- Conhecimento em frameworks de qualidade de dados e governança.


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de Contrato: Terceirizado (Projeto de Expansão).

Horário: Segunda a sexta, das 08h às 18h - 100% REMOTO

Remuneração: Compatível com o mercado.

Benefícios: Assistência Médica, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte e Seguro de Vida.


Palavras-chave: Data Engineer, Engenharia de Dados, HR Analytics, Databricks, Azure, Python, SQL, ETL, ELT, Data Lakehouse, LGPD, LATAM, Data Governance.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Recruiter based in Latin America with 2 to 5 years of experience and excellent English skills, who has a keen eye for detail and a knack for finding ways to get it done.


We are a growth-stage company that works fast and smart. We want ambitious people who want to grow their skills. At Velozient, you will feel your contribution daily to the success of the team! We are not a huge company where you will get lost in the mix or stuck in a role.


Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the Talent Pipeline and candidate engagement.
  • Conduct 1:1 interviews with qualified candidates.
  • Continuously assess and improve the recruitment process for efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Screen all the candidates and evaluate their fit for the opening.
  • Implement best practices to streamline workflows and enhance the overall recruitment experience.
  • Proactively conduct the full life cycle of identifying, engaging, and evaluating top candidates.
  • Collaborate with internal Resource Managers to ensure Velozient meets and exceeds client hiring goals, budgets, and performance standards.
  • Assure accurate/timely issuance of offer letters and clean/effective transition of candidates to the onboarding team.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & EXPERIENCE

REQUIRED (Must Have):

  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in Recruiting, with at least two years in Technical Recruitment.
  • Proficiency in using social media platforms for networking purposes.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Familiarity with ApplicantTracking Systems and other recruitment tools is a plus.


Preferred (But not required):

  • University degree
  • Prior work for another North American-based company
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced, growth-stage, entrepreneurial company


What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

title: Especialista em Governança, Arquitetura e FinOps em Ambientes Multicloud (Temporário)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades/Atividades

  • Avaliação sobre existência de processo de desligamento de recursos e análise de consumo;
  • Avaliação do processo de Bilhetagem Multicloud controlado pelo Broker (tecnicamente consistente, transparente, rastreável, íntegro e aderente aos contratos de multicloud);
  • Avaliação do processo de integração Bilhetagem × Arquitetura × FinOps (decisões técnicas consideram impacto na bilhetagem futura, consumo observado pelo Broker é utilizado para corrigir arquitetura e feedback entre custo x engenharia x arquitetura);
  • Avaliar se a empresa conhece e considera o uso dos recursos nativos disponíveis nos CSPs já contratados (Azure, AWS, GCP, etc), especialmente para custo e previsibilidade;
  • Avaliação sobre a existência de uma análise de custo × benefício antes da decisão sobre a arquitetura utilizada (tráfego entre clouds, serviços premium, lock-in);
  • Participação em discussões e reuniões técnicas para entendimento e avaliação do ambiente de multicloud.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Ensino superior completo. Área de formação: Ciências da Computação, Sistemas da Informação, Engenharia, e/ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos

  • Experiência prática comprovada em ambientes multicloud (desejável pelo menos AWS e Azure);
  • Vivência com ambientes que usam mais de um CSP em paralelo;
  • Análise crítica de dependência excessiva de um CSP e riscos de lock-in, impactos arquiteturais de decisões financeiras;
  • Entendimento claro de princípios de FinOps, relação entre consumo técnico e custo (obrigatório );
  • Experiência avaliando consumo, desperdício e eficiência em ambientes cloud (obrigatório) ;
  • Capacidade de analisar impacto de arquitetura no custo e decisões técnicas vs. impacto financeiro (obrigatório) ;
  • Experiência avaliando modelos de Cloud Broker e processo de bilhetagem multicloud (obrigatório) ;
  • Capacidade de Benchmark e Referenciais de Mercado em relação a modelos adotados por grandes empresas e boas práticas de mercado;
  • Capacidade de apresentar alternativas, padrões e caminhos possíveis;
  • Capacidade de discutir tecnicamente em alto nível levando em consideração tendências e soluções de cloud adotadas pelo mercado.


Habilidades e Atitudes Desejáveis

  • Disponibilidade para atuação temporária em um único projeto - 1 a 2 meses.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva junto ao cliente.
  • Comprometimento e responsabilidades com as entregas de projetos nos prazos e com qualidade esperada.

title: Senior Closer
description:
The Differs Company

A The Differs Company ajuda criadores, marcas e empreendedores a se destacarem no digital através de posicionamento estratégico, branding e conteúdos de alto impacto .


Nosso ecossistema inclui mentorias, cursos, consultorias e suporte para crescimento real de negócios, sempre orientado a resultados concretos . Trabalhamos diretamente com o perfil da @ketherink no Instagram, cuja audiência engajada soma centenas de milhares de seguidores , oferecendo oportunidades de venda tanto B2C quanto B2B.


Descrição da vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) closer para trabalhar 100% remotamente, com experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas , que saiba conduzir leads do primeiro contato até o fechamento, sem desistir no meio do caminho.


Você será responsável por:


  • Conduzir calls estratégicas com leads qualificados
  • Diagnosticar o cenário do cliente e propor soluções de alto valor
  • Fechar vendas de mentorias, produtos digitais e consultorias B2B
  • Lidar com objeções de forma madura e estratégica
  • Manter registro completo das interações em CRM


﻿Oportunidade de crescimento:  quem performar acima da média poderá atuar em vendas B2B de tickets mais altos e consultorias estratégicas.


Qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada como closer e em vendas consultivas
  • Capacidade de sustentar a negociação até o fechamento
  • Perfil persistente, estratégico e orientado a resultados
  • Habilidade de lidar com objeções complexas
  • Diferencial: experiência em vendas de mentorias ou produtos de alto valor
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva, com repertório para conversar com clientes exigentes
  • Excelente em gramática da Língua Portuguesa


Como se candidatar

Envie via inbox:

  • Um breve texto de apresentação
  • Uma gravação real de call de vendas  para análise


Se você sabe fechar vendas de forma consistente  e quer crescer em um ambiente de alta performance, essa é sua oportunidade.

title: Customer Support Specialist (POS)
description:
Provide technical support for our client's Point of Sale to ensure the stable operation of

customer hardware and software products. This includes troubleshooting, configuring,

maintaining, supporting, and optimizing all Point of Sale products, PC

hardware, software, and communication links. This job requires a technical understanding

of IT, an appreciation of the food industry, and strong customer service skills.

Essential Responsibilities and Duties:


  • Provide first class Technical Support over the phone
  • Identify, analyze, and correct technical and software issues
  • Work customer cases efficiently with the goal of optimizing and improving customer

satisfaction

  • Ensure customers issues are dealt with in a timely fashion
  • Ensure that customer satisfaction is maintained
  • Maintain an available status to provide quick response times for customers calls
  • Work closely with other departments to provide prompt resolutions to customer

issues


Education :

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)
  • Preferred – Associates Degree (or higher)


Experience:

  • Must Have: 1-3 years of experience in computer technology (prior help desk or call center experiences supporting a software product a big plus)
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Technical certifications (examples: Net+, CompTIA A+ or an AAS degree or equivalent)
  • Previous experience working in the hospitality industry
  • Familiarity with POS equipment
  • Bilingual Speaker (preferable) (Spanish/English)


What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills
  • Be able to technically troubleshoot and reverse engineer:

1. Windows

2. Networking

3. SQL Server (preferred)

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (C#/.NET)
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js, Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.


You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.

The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Company Description

We are a software startup dedicated to unifying ERP and CRM solutions into one seamless platform. As we prepare for growth, we are seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer that has hands-on experience, particularly with integrations and solution design and implementation.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote position for a Salesforce Developer. The Salesforce Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and customizing Salesforce solutions, including creating and optimizing Visualforce Pages and Lightning Web Components. Responsibilities also include Salesforce.com administration, integration with other enterprise applications, troubleshooting, and maintaining scalable and secure solutions. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to meet business requirements is integral to this role. While remote, this role will be working during Eastern Standard Timezone (US) hours from 8am to 5pm.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and customize Salesforce applications using Lightning and Apex
  • Collaborate with functional teams to gather and analyze business requirements
  • Build scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions
  • Perform debugging, testing, and deployment activities
  • Provide ongoing support and enhancements to existing applications


Qualifications

  • In-depth understanding of Salesforce.com platform capabilities and customization
  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or related field
  • Strong expertise in Salesforce Lightning (LWC/Aura)
  • Experience with Agentic AI or AI-based solutions is a plus
  • Solid understanding of Apex, Triggers, Workflows, SOQL/SOSL, and integrations
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with Salesforce.com Administration tasks and configuration
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with cross-functional teams

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote, global environment

Company Perks & Benefits

  • Observance of major US Federal Holidays
  • 10 Paid Vacation Days + 5 Personal Days + 5 Sick Days in the 1st year of employment

title: Engineering Design Specialist
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and a global leader in innovative IT solutions, with offices in London, UK, and a state-of-the-art development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in transformative, future-ready solutions, including Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, with a strong focus on Oracle Cloud and database technologies. Backed by over 45+ technology experts and led by visionary leadership, MillionLogics delivers tailored and results-driven technology solutions. Committed to empowering organizations worldwide, the company embraces innovation and excellence to drive digital transformation. To learn more, visit: millionlogics.com.


Role Overview

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.


Offer Details :

  • Contract Duration : 12 months
  • Pay : US $200 (take-home) per task
  • Experience : 3+ years
  • Positions : 98
  • Work Mode : Remote


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  •  Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks

  • You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the following; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.
  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualification:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Nice to Have

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round.


How to Apply: Please send us your updated CV to with Job ID- 72123 as your email subject.

title: LLM Scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist \" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.


Key Responsibilities

Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.

Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.

Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.

Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.

Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.


Qualification Required

Extensive experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).

Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.

Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS SageMaker/GCP Vertex Al).

Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.


Nice to Have

Advanced Degree: A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.

Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.

Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).

Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public GitHub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the GenAl space.

Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.


About Our Client

Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.


Benefits & Wellbeing

Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.

The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees’ well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: [Tech] Agile Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Atuar como facilitador e agente de transformação ágil, promovendo a cultura de melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a colaboração entre os times. Seu papel será apoiar equipes multifuncionais na adoção e maturidade de práticas ágeis, além de impulsionar a eficiência dos processos e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Capacitar e treinar pessoas em ferramentas, métodos e processos ágeis, promovendo o conhecimento contínuo e a autonomia dos times;
  • Atuar como agente de mudança, questionando e provocando reflexões que fomentem o crescimento coletivo;
  • Praticar escuta ativa, acolhendo e auxiliando nas questões individuais dos membros do time;
  • Apoiar as squads na construção de senso de pertencimento e na busca por alta performance;
  • Implementar práticas e ferramentas ágeis de acordo com o contexto e maturidade dos times;
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis, workshops de ideação, resolução de problemas e retrospectivas;
  • Gerenciar métricas relacionadas à eficiência dos processos e à saúde cultural dos times;
  • Estruturar processos de rotina e gestão do conhecimento para garantir a fluidez do trabalho;
  • Ajudar os times na construção e condução de processos de experimentação e validação de hipóteses;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria e gargalos no dia a dia das squads, atuando de forma colaborativa para solucioná-los;
  • Apoiar a estruturação e reorganização de tribos, promovendo sinergia entre as equipes;
  • Remover impedimentos e garantir que os times tenham um ambiente propício à entrega de valor.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, XP);
  • Conhecimento em OKRs e práticas de gestão como Management 3.0;
  • Técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas colaborativas;
  • Experiência em mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento ágil (Jira, Confluence, Miro, etc.);
  • Habilidade para atuar com métricas de performance e cultura de times.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações em metodologias ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, ICP-ATF, etc.);
  • Experiência como Agile Coach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;
  • Vivência com escalabilidade ágil (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model);
  • Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
  • Conhecimento em cultura DevOps e Design Thinking.
  • Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Join Manukora, the #1 D2C Manuka Business in the USA.

Are you someone who thrives on taking charge, driving results, and staying steps ahead? Do you excel in fast-paced settings and possess an intuitive ability to understand and fulfill the needs of a dynamic team? If this resonates with you, an exciting opportunity awaits!


We’re looking for a creative, data-savvy, and proactive Video Editor to craft high-performing social media content for our fast-growing brand. This role is fully remote, with preference for some overlap with PST working hours. You’ll be at the heart of Manukora’s storytelling engine — transforming briefs into thumb-stopping, results-driven content for multiple social platforms.


This is a high-trust, high-autonomy position suited for someone who’s self-directed, obsessed with craft, and energized by creative momentum.


What You’ll Do

  • Create compelling, high-performance social media ads that align with creative briefs and drive measurable results
  • Design dynamic motion graphics, text animations, and visual effects that enhance storytelling and brand messaging
  • Collaborate closely with strategists, creative leads, and editors to optimize video and graphics content tailored for social platforms
  • Apply performance insights and creative feedback to continually refine and elevate ad effectiveness
  • Take creative ownership of projects while remaining highly receptive to feedback and iteration
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met
  • Maintain organized and efficient Adobe project files


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience creating engaging digital content for social media platforms
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills with a strong foundation in storytelling and pacing
  • Intermediate+ Adobe After Effects proficiency (motion graphics, kinetic typography, and visual effects)
  • Deep understanding of social media optimization and platform-specific best practices
  • Excellent English communication skills (written & verbal) for effective collaboration with international teams
  • Quick learner who thrives on feedback, adapts rapidly to new challenges, and takes ownership of creative work
  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced, results-driven environment


Bonus Points For

  • Experience with AI-powered creative tools (Midjourney, RunwayML, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Digital advertising agency or performance marketing experience
  • Proven track record optimizing video content for social media algorithms
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud Libraries and collaborative workflows
  • Background in data-driven creative optimization

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description:
Data Analyst

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Approximately 6 months

Compensation: R$9,802.52 monthly (Full-Time Equivalent)


Position Overview

The BMP (Business Model and Pricing) Analytics team is seeking an experienced Data Analyst to support business performance management and strategic decision-making through advanced analytics.

In this role, you will partner closely with leadership, finance, operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate business performance, analyze customer behavior, and drive data-informed decisions across the organization.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex problems, and can effectively translate data into actionable insights for senior stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify business questions, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities, translating them into structured analytical approaches
  • Deliver insights on business performance, operational efficiency, financial drivers, and key strategic KPIs
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models to support decision-making
  • Conduct ad hoc and deep-dive analyses to explain trends, variances, risks, and opportunities
  • Partner with stakeholders to define metrics and ensure alignment with business objectives
  • Collaborate with data engineering, finance, and analytics teams to ensure data quality and scalable reporting solutions
  • Translate complex data into clear, concise insights and present findings to senior leadership
  • Contribute to improving analytical frameworks, tools, and best practices within the team


Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or a related quantitative field
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business analytics, or performance management
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (e.g., Python)
  • Experience with BI tools (preferably Power BI ) for dashboarding and reporting
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional environments
  • Fluency in English


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial analytics or business performance management
  • Familiarity with advanced analytics (forecasting, statistical analysis, scenario modeling)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS)
  • Knowledge of data pipelines, automation, or orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow)
  • Exposure to big data technologies (e.g., Spark, PySpark)
  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization

title: DevOps (Jr/Pl)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa DevOps (Jr/Pl) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:

  • Atuar de forma autônoma na implementação e sustentação técnica de sistemas em ambiente produtivo, realizando análises, troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes;
  • Executar e acompanhar mudanças controladas (change requests), garantindo avaliação de impacto e estabilidade dos serviços;
  • Investigar causa raiz de falhas, analisando logs, integrações e comportamento das aplicações;
  • Gerenciar demandas via Jira, acompanhando fluxo até a resolução e garantindo comunicação com as áreas envolvidas;
  • Realizar suporte técnico ao cliente em cenários de falha ou implantação, conduzindo alinhamentos quando necessário documentar.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Experiência com suporte e sustentação de sistemas em ambiente produtivo;
  • Experiência com troubleshooting e investigação de causa raiz;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados/demandas (ex.: Jira);
  • Experiência em implantação técnica e validação pós-implementação em ambiente produtivo;
  • Vivência com gestão e execução de change requests, incluindo análise de impacto;
  • Conhecimento em Linux para troubleshooting (serviços, portas, processos e logs);
  • Conhecimento operacional em Docker e Kong para análise e suporte de aplicações (não administração de infraestrutura);
  • Capacidade de redigir documentação técnica e atendimentos de forma estruturada;
  • Espanhol intermediário para comunicação operacional.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Experiência com análise de logs e integrações entre sistemas;
  • Experiência com ambientes críticos ou de alta disponibilidade;
  • Vivência em atendimento a clientes ou suporte técnico B2B;
  • Noções de redes, certificados digitais e comunicação entre serviços;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Account Executive
description:
A Accountfy está crescendo e estamos buscando um(a) AE que queira crescer junto.

Se você sabe conduzir conversas complexas com tomadores de decisão, transformar dores em argumentos de valor e fechar negócios com consistência, essa pode ser a sua próxima casa.


O que você vai fazer

Você será o ponto central entre o cliente e a solução, do primeiro diagnóstico ao contrato assinado. Seu trabalho não é empurrar software: é entender o contexto do cliente e mostrar, com clareza, como a Accountfy muda o jogo para ele.


Na prática, isso significa:

  • Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas, da prospecção ao fechamento;
  • Mapear dores e construir propostas com foco em ROI, produtividade e inteligência financeira;
  • Apresentar para C-levels e tomadores de decisão com confiança e profundidade;
  • Colaborar com pré-vendas, produto e implantação para garantir uma jornada sem atritos;
  • Usar o CRM com disciplina e orientar suas decisões por dados.


O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B de soluções complexas ou customizáveis;
  • Histórico com clientes Enterprise ou Mid-Market;
  • Capacidade de conduzir o funil completo com autonomia;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa e habilidade de influenciar sem pressionar.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Familiaridade com o universo financeiro: DRE, FP&A, fechamento contábil (não precisa ser contador, precisa saber conversar com um);
  • Experiência com SaaS financeiro, ERP ou soluções de gestão para escritórios contábeis ou departamentos financeiros.

title: Consultor Basis
description:
A Softtek está em busca de um(a) Consultor Basis para fazer parte do nosso time e atuar em projetos desafiadores e de grande relevância!

  • Experiência sólida como Consultor SAP BASIS, com atuação em ambientes S/4HANA.

title: Engenheiro (a) de Automação Sênior - Remoto
description:
We are looking for a hands‑on Automation Engineer ,who will design and build process automations across Azure, AWS, and Cortex XSOAR.


Unlike typical SOC automation roles, this position focuses on process and workflow automation, data orchestration, and cross‑platform integrations.


This job profile is for a senior Automation Engineer, focused on process automation and multi-cloud orchestration, much closer to automation


Experience with Agentic AI, LLM‑assisted automation patterns, or orchestration using AI-driven decision logic is considered a plus.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, build, and deploy cloud-native automation workflows, including:


  • Azure: Functions, Logic Apps


  • AWS: Glue Jobs, Lambda, Step Functions, S3


  • Develop and maintain Cortex XSOAR playbooks, integrations, Python scripts, and automation modules tailored to process automation scenarios.


  • Create cross-platform orchestration pipelines (e.g., XSOAR → Azure → AWS) to support data flows, enrichment, and workflow execution.


  • Build reusable automation templates and components for repeatability and rapid iteration.


  • Implement automation CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, etc.).


  • Ensure all automations adhere to ISRM quality standards, security requirements, and best practices.


  • Conduct testing, validation, and documentation of automation workflows.


  • Collaborate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of the automation capability.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong hands-on engineering experience with Azure and AWS automation services.


  • Practical experience building solutions using Cortex XSOAR (playbooks, integrations, Python automations).


  • Solid understanding of process automation, event-driven architecture, and cloud orchestration patterns.


  • Experience working with APIs, data transformation, and multi-system integrations.


  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and deployment automation practices.


  • Ability to work in Agile teams and communicate effectively with process owners and technical teams.


  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate process requirements into technical solutions.



Preferred Skills:


  • Knowledge of Agentic AI, LLM-driven automation, or autonomous workflow orchestration.


  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, identity platforms, or data services.


  • Experience designing modular and configuration-driven automation frameworks

Responsabilidades:

Os consultores Cientista de dados - IA/ML trabalham em estreita colaboração com os clientes para implementar e gerenciar soluções de IA da AWS que atendam aos seus requisitos técnicos e objetivos de negócios. Trabalham em estreita colaboração com as partes interessadas para coletar requisitos, avaliar a infraestrutura atual e propor estratégias eficazes para implementar soluções de IA na AWS.

  • Projetar e implementar soluções de IA da AWS complexas, escaláveis e seguras, adaptadas às necessidades do cliente;
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e suporte para solução de problemas durante toda a execução do projeto;
  • Colaborar com as partes interessadas para coletar requisitos e propor estratégias eficazes de implementação de IA;
  • Atuar como consultor de confiança para os clientes sobre tendências do setor e tecnologias emergentes em IA;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento dentro da organização por meio de mentoria, treinamento e criação de artefatos reutilizáveis.

Requisitos :

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada, ou combinação equivalente de formação acadêmica e experiência prática;
  • Experiência relevante no desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos e/ou sistemas de aprendizado de máquina ou aprendizado profundo em larga escala em produção, incluindo processamento de dados em lote e em tempo real;
  • Processamento de dados em lote e em tempo real;
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e experiência prática em engenharia de ponta, implantação e hospedagem de Modelos Fundamentais de Grande Porte;
  • Experiência com serviços de IA da AWS, como SageMaker, Bedrock e outros serviços de ML;

title: Implementation Analyst
description:
Job Title: Implementation Analyst


English Resume Only


Location: Brazil

Setup: Fully Remote

Level: Mid-Level

Industry: Software SAAS Company

Shift: US Hours

Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer

Equipment: Available upon request

Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000


About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.


Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Sr Data & Analytics Engineer \"#999885\"
description:
Quem Somos

“A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento de engenharia de sistemas.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Our client is looking for a Data & Analytics Engineer with a passion for data and strong analytics capabilities to help grow our business. The Data & Analytics Engineer will support profitable and sustainable sales strategies with customers and help develop advanced sales reporting and analytics capabilities for scale. This person will champion our mission to be data-driven and will possess strong interpersonal skills, robust technical and data analysis capabilities, and a natural sense of curiosity that drives them to identify trends and promote opportunities. The position is sure to develop one’s leadership, management, and analytics capabilities as well as provide an exciting career path. The role is highly visible with broad exposure to senior leaders across the business.

Key Responsibilities

· Leverage data tools to provide reporting and insights which will further develop company and retailer objectives.

· Create and maintain customer scorecards inclusive of key metrics such as volume, share, distribution, weekly sales ranks, store performance, etc.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.

· Responsible for developing and running weekly and monthly brand reports to help partnership teams understand trends.

· Ability to prioritize work and key projects based on the needs of the team and the business

· Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines to move and transform data from disparate sources (Excel, ERP, CRM, operational systems) into the enterprise data warehouse (Snowflake).

· Develop and manage data models (dimensional and semantic layers) that enable analysts and business users to access trusted, well-structured data for reporting.

· Collaborate with analysts and business stakeholders to translate reporting/analytics needs into scalable data solutions while documenting definitions and lineage.

· Ad-hoc requests/projects as needed.


O que você precisa ter:

· Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.

· 5+ years of experience data engineering, ETL/ELT development, or analytics engineering

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data engineering or related field, OR equivalent hands-on experience

· Proficient in SQL (writing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex queries)

· Understanding of database concepts such as database structures, query languages (SQL), and data warehousing principles.

· Experience working with ETL and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, other).

· Proven track record of building collaborative relationships across functional areas.

· Self-starter with an ability to drive projects from initiation to completion.

· Adept at prioritizing work and key projects based on the needs of the team and the business.


Onde você vai trabalhar:

Regime remoto, qualquer lugar do Brasil.

title: Designer Gráfico com IA
description:
A Dropservice é a base por trás do crescimento de um ecossistema de marcas. Conectamos pessoas, processos e dados para que nossas marcas cresçam com clareza, eficiência e impacto nos maiores marketplaces do mundo, como Amazon e TikTok Shop.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Designer Freelancer para criação de imagens e vídeos de produtos orientados à conversão, trabalhando por demanda, com flexibilidade de horários e participação em projetos dinâmicos de marketing e e-commerce.


Se você gosta de unir design + IA + vendas, ama testar criativos diferentes e quer atuar em um fluxo contínuo de produtos e campanhas, essa oportunidade é para você.


Etapa obrigatória do processo


Antes de se candidatar pelo LinkedIn, pedimos que preencha o formulário abaixo. Ele é etapa obrigatória para que seu perfil seja considerado no processo seletivo.

O formulário nos ajuda a conduzir o processo com mais agilidade, clareza e transparência.

Acesse aqui:

Caso o link não apareça clicável, copie e cole diretamente no seu navegador.

Importante: Candidaturas sem o formulário preenchido não serão consideradas para análise.



O que você vai fazer


  • Criar imagens e vídeos de produtos com foco em conversão para: páginas de produto, anúncios, vitrines e criativos para e-commerce/marketplaces.
  • Desenvolver materiais baseados em intenção, destacar benefícios reais do produto, mostrar uso, diferenciais e provas visuais, testar ângulos, composições e mensagens que aumentem a taxa de clique e de compra.


Quem é a pessoa ideal para essa vaga


  • Experiência prévia como designer gráfico ou motion designer criando peças para vendas online: e-commerce, marketplaces, anúncios, páginas de produto ou lançamentos digitais.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de IA para criação/aprimoramento de imagens e/ou vídeos.
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Premiere, After Effects, CapCut ou similares (não precisa saber todas, mas deve dominar bem o combo que usa).


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com Amazon, marketplaces ou infoprodutos.
  • Noções de copy para criativos (headline, benefício, CTA).
  • Experiência em testes A/B de criativos e otimização contínua.


Como será o processo seletivo


  • Preenchimento do forms – ANTES de finalizar a candidatura no LinkedIn.
  • Análise do forms + portfólio.
  • Envio de um teste prático curto, com prazo de entrega combinado.
  • Feedback direto (aprovado ou não) após análise do teste.
  • Possível conversa por vídeo para alinhar expectativas de demanda e formato de trabalho.


Modelo de trabalho


 Contratação:  Freelancer – por demanda / por pacote de entregas (não é vaga fixa CLT ou PJ mensal).

 Local:  100% remoto.

 Remuneração:  a combinar por pacote de artes e vídeos / projeto, de acordo com escopo e complexidade.

title: Lead Crypto Research Analyst
description:
About Ideal Concept Holding (ICH)

Ideal Concept Holding is a diversified investment group with a robust portfolio spanning retail, construction, real estate, and general trading across the UAE, Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. As we expand our global footprint, we are integrating digital asset strategies to optimize treasury management, explore tokenization of real-world assets (RWA), and identify high-potential Web3 investment opportunities. We combine traditional business stability with forward-looking technological innovation.


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Lead Crypto Research Analyst to head our digital assets research initiative. Based remotely in Brazil, you will serve as the primary intelligence source for the executive team, identifying emerging trends, evaluating early-stage Web3 projects, and providing data-driven recommendations for capital allocation.

This is not a trading role. It is a fundamental research position focused on due diligence, risk assessment, and strategic advisory. You will help ICH navigate the complex landscape of blockchain technology, ensuring that our exposure to digital assets is compliant, secure, and aligned with long-term corporate goals.


Key Responsibilities

  • Fundamental Research & Due Diligence: Conduct deep-dive analysis of Web3 sectors (DeFi, Infrastructure, RWA, Layer 2s, Gaming). Evaluate projects based on technology, team credibility, tokenomics, and market fit.
  • Investment Thesis Development: Create and maintain actionable investment theses for the CIO and Board. Identify undervalued opportunities and potential risks in the crypto market.
  • On-Chain Analytics: Utilize tools like Dune Analytics, Nansen, Etherscan, and DefiLlama to verify project metrics, track user growth, monitor whale activity, and assess network health.
  • Tokenomics Modeling: Analyze token distribution models, vesting schedules, inflation rates, and utility mechanisms to identify sustainable projects vs. speculative pumps.
  • Executive Reporting: Prepare concise, high-impact investment memorandums and weekly market intelligence briefings for senior leadership.
  • Regulatory & Risk Monitoring: Stay updated on global regulatory developments (including Brazil’s CVM guidelines, MiCA in EU, and VARA in UAE) and assess their impact on ICH’s strategy.
  • Portfolio Support: Monitor existing digital asset holdings or pilot projects, providing regular performance reports and rebalancing recommendations.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in financial research, equity analysis, or venture capital, with at least 2–3 years specifically focused on Crypto/Web3 assets.
  • Technical Depth: Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, DeFi primitives, ZK-proofs). Ability to read technical whitepapers and audit reports.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus.
  • Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.g., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles.
  • Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination.
  • Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location).
  • Performance Bonus: Annual bonus tied to the accuracy of research insights and successful identification of opportunities.
  • Flexible Payment: Option to receive a portion of compensation in Stablecoins (USDC/USDT) or Fiat (BRL/USD), compliant with local laws.
  • Professional Growth: Budget for premium research tools (Messari, Token Terminal) and industry conferences.

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior - IA/ML - 132144
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional Cientista de Dados de nível Sênior que atue com (IAML/AWS).

Responsabilidades:

Os consultores Cientista de dados - IA/ML trabalham em estreita colaboração com os clientes para implementar e gerenciar soluções de IA da AWS que atendam aos seus requisitos técnicos e objetivos de negócios. Impulsionam o sucesso do cliente em sua jornada para a nuvem, fornecendo conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto. Projetam soluções de IA escaláveis e seguras, personalizadas para atender às necessidades específicas de cada cliente. Trabalham em estreita colaboração com as partes interessadas para coletar requisitos, avaliar a infraestrutura atual e propor estratégias eficazes para implementar soluções de IA na AWS.

  • Projetar e implementar soluções de IA da AWS complexas, escaláveis e seguras, adaptadas às necessidades do cliente;
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e suporte para solução de problemas durante toda a execução do projeto;
  • Colaborar com as partes interessadas para coletar requisitos e propor estratégias eficazes de implementação de IA;
  • Atuar como consultor de confiança para os clientes sobre tendências do setor e tecnologias emergentes em IA;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento dentro da organização por meio de mentoria, treinamento e criação de artefatos reutilizáveis.

Requisitos :

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada, ou combinação equivalente de formação acadêmica e experiência prática;
  • Experiência relevante no desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos e/ou sistemas de aprendizado de máquina ou aprendizado profundo em larga escala em produção, incluindo processamento de dados em lote e em tempo real;
  • Processamento de dados em lote e em tempo real;
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e experiência prática em engenharia de ponta, implantação e hospedagem de Modelos Fundamentais de Grande Porte;
  • Experiência com serviços de IA da AWS, como SageMaker, Bedrock e outros serviços de ML;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de código de software em uma ou mais linguagens de programação (Java, JavaScript, Python, etc.).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em uma ampla gama de serviços da AWS (por exemplo, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation);
  • Experiência com automação e scripts (por exemplo, Terraform, Python);
  • Certificações AWS (por exemplo, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate)

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!


Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!


Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack - Pleno para se unir ao nosso Time de Dev-Digital Security para:

  • Participação do ciclo de vida completo do desenvolvimento de projetos de Software;

  • Apoio ao cliente em dúvidas relacionadas com a integração com os nossos produtos.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Experiência com Java 17+, SpringBoot, APIs REST, Arquitetura de microsserviços, CI/CD;
  • Experiência com planejamento, e estimava de desenvolvimento de Software;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Orchestrador;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura baseada a eventos, e serviços de mensageria;
  • Conhecimento em HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React;
  • Conhecimento de segurança no front-end;
  • Conhecimento de responsividade;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento de código e práticas CI/CD (Git);
  • Conhecimento sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software/engenharia de software, da concepção à entrega;
  • Conhecimento dos principais Design Patterns;
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de desenvolvimento: SOLID, K.I.S.S, Clean Code;
  • Conhecimento de base de dados (SQL, noSql);
  • Conhecimento de testes unitários;
  • Proficiência na qualidade das entregas e do funcionamento das soluções desenvolvidas como um todo.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento em análise e aperfeiçoamento de performance de APIs;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos ou com conceitos relacionados a meios de pagamento.

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratações em regime CLT;

Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.


Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.
